financial_covenants.name: Debt Service Coverage Ratio

citation.source_text: the Debt Service Coverage Ratio shall be less than 1.10 to 1.00

financial_covenants.definition: as of the last day of the calendar month immediately preceding the applicable date of calculation, the quotient obtained by dividing (1) the Adjusted Net Cash Flow by (2) the aggregate principal and interest projected to be due and payable over the twelve (12) month period subsequent to the date of calculation (interest only periods will be disregarded for purposes of this calculation) and a 30-year amortization period. Borrower shall deliver to Lender such information as is reasonably required for Lender to make all applicable calculations. Lender’s calculation of the Debt Service Coverage Ratio, and all component calculations, shall be conclusive and binding on Borrower absent manifest error.

resolved_definition.formula: (NOI - Normalized TI/Leasing Commissions - Normalized Capital Improvements) / (Aggregate Principal and Interest Due over 12 months + Principal Due over remaining 30-year amortization)

Adjusted Net Cash Flow.formula: NOI - Normalized TI/Leasing Commissions - Normalized Capital Improvements
